verified_facts.text: The hotel is situated between Surfers Paradise and Broadbeach on the Gold Coast.
The hotel is conveniently accessed through Gold Coast and Brisbane International Airports.

verified_facts.text: T'ang Court is the hotel's contemporary Cantonese restaurant, pairing local produce with a bespoke wine list.
verified_facts.excerpt: T'ang Court embraces the essence of the Southern Chinese region and its surroundings, and adorns your plate with the finest local produce

verified_facts.text: Akoya is a beachfront restaurant built around fresh, seasonal, locally sourced ingredients.

verified_facts.text: Palm Court serves the Langham Afternoon Tea, a contemporary interpretation of the tea service first served at The Langham, London in 1865.
